0.description: An upright certificate has a folded upper right corner and three short text lines. A round seal overlaps the lower right edge, with a two-point ribbon hanging beneath the seal.

2.description: A hamburger has a large domed upper bun above a thick rounded filling layer and a curved lower bun. The three broad sections meet along horizontal seams without additional surface marks.

3.description: A broad telephone receiver rests above a sloping desk base with rounded corners. Nine short keypad marks form three rows across the front, leaving a clear gap beneath the curved handset.

4.description: A wide curved receiver sits across a tapered telephone base, joined by a short central cradle. A large blank circular dial occupies the front, above the gently rounded lower corners.

5.description: A short pea coat has wide pointed lapels overlapping diagonally across the upper chest. Long sleeves angle outward beside a straight lower body, with a central opening descending toward the curved hem.

6.description: A classical column has a straight rectangular shaft marked by three long vertical flutes. A broad rounded capital projects above a curved collar, balanced by a wide rounded base below.

7.description: A tall pedestal has a narrow straight shaft between a broad rectangular top and base. Curved supporting moldings widen beneath the upper slab and above the lower block in a balanced arrangement.

8.description: A broad semicircular food cover rests on a shallow platter with upturned rounded ends. A small rounded knob rises from the center of the dome, above the straight horizontal serving rim.

9.description: A peacock head faces right on a long curved neck with a pointed projecting beak. A broad curved crest rises behind the crown, and one tiny eye marks the blank face.

10.description: An acoustic guitar tilts upward to the right across a diagonal microphone. The guitar has a round sound hole and short bridge, while the microphone's rounded head and narrow handle project behind it.

14.description: A fountain pen nib rises from a short rounded rectangular base into a pointed diamond-shaped tip. A narrow central slit descends from the tip to a small circular opening inside the nib.

15.description: A curved croissant forms a broad crescent with two rounded tapered ends pointing downward. Several curved seams cross the plump upper body, separating the rolled pastry into overlapping sections.

16.description: A broad peach narrows into a pointed lower tip beneath two rounded upper lobes. A short curved stem and one pointed leaf rise above a long crease descending through the fruit.

19.description: A large hand extends from the right and rests across the top of a blank oval head. The person's narrow neck joins sloping shoulders below, while the fingers curve over the crown.

28.description: A long slender fish faces left with a pointed muzzle and forked tail on the right. A short gill curve marks the head, with small fins projecting above and below the narrow body.

29.description: A pheasant faces left with a small head and rounded chest above two thin legs. Its curved wing ends near the body, while a long narrow tail rises diagonally to the upper right.

31.description: A pickaxe lies diagonally with a long rounded handle rising from the lower left. A broad curved metal head crosses the handle near the top, tapering into two sharp opposing points.

32.description: A long diagonal handle passes beneath a crescent-shaped pickaxe head with sharply tapered ends. A short rounded handle cap projects beyond the head, opposite the extended rounded grip at the lower left.

34.description: A round piggy bank faces right with a short square snout and pointed ear. Two stubby feet support the body, a curled tail extends left, and a horizontal coin slot crosses the back.

38.description: A picnic table has a wide trapezoid tabletop divided into rectangular planks. Two slanting legs spread beneath it, crossed by a long horizontal bench line that extends past both sides.

40.description: A large round plate with several small circular food portions sits behind a square piece of matzah. Short broken horizontal lines cross the matzah, which overlaps the plate at the lower right.

44.description: A squat squash has a broad scalloped upper outline and rounded lower lobes. A short curved stem rises from the center, while two long curved grooves descend toward the base.

45.description: A rectangular pavement slab recedes toward a narrower far edge, with a thick rounded front lip. Staggered brick seams divide the surface into three broad rows of long rectangular paving blocks.

46.description: A hand raises two long fingers into a wide V above a rounded palm. The other fingers curl inward beside a folded thumb, with a short palm crease beneath the crossing thumb.

47.description: A broad pencil tilts from a pointed lower left tip toward a rounded upper right end. A loose curling line runs beside the tip, bending downward across the left side of the drawing.

48.description: An irregular land shape has a broad upper section and a rounded lower projection. Two separate curved wave lines follow its indented left edge, bending around the lower part of the shoreline.

54.description: A round pickleball contains four small circular holes spaced irregularly across its face. The broad outer circle remains unmarked, with the holes distributed above and below the open center.

55.description: A smooth skin contour rises into a rounded central bump and slopes gently downward on both sides. A small circular spot sits below the crest, inside the raised area of the skin.

56.description: A spread animal hide has a broad symmetrical body with inward-curving sides and projecting rounded corners. Shallow scoops shape the upper edge, while a short pointed tail extends from the lower center.

57.concept: Curved Telephone Receiver with Ring Line
57.description: A large telephone receiver curves diagonally between two rounded end pieces. A short detached arc follows its lower left edge, echoing the handset's curve outside the otherwise blank outline.

58.description: A circular sewing button has four round holes arranged as a square near its center. The holes are evenly spaced inside a broad plain rim, with no thread crossing between them.

59.description: A plain guitar pick has a narrow rounded point at the top and broad curved lower corners. Its smooth sides widen downward around a blank interior before joining the gently bowed base.

60.description: A closed notebook has rounded outer corners and a narrow spine strip along the left edge. Two short horizontal title lines sit on the blank front cover, with the upper line longer.

61.description: A round pendulum weight hangs from a long straight vertical cord. The cord joins the center of the circle's upper edge, leaving the rest of the weight's interior completely blank.

62.description: A pavilion has a wide triangular roof extending beyond two straight side supports. A low rectangular base spans the opening below, with a horizontal division separating its upper and lower sections.

63.description: A broad bench has a tall rounded rectangular backrest above a shallow projecting seat. The seat's front edge is thick and rounded, with two slim legs descending from beneath its ends.

64.description: A separate circular head sits above a wide torso with rounded shoulders and a shallow curved neckline. Short vertical sleeve divisions rise from the straight lower edge near either side of the body.

65.description: A sleeveless pinafore has two broad shoulder straps surrounding a deep square neckline. A straight waist seam divides the fitted upper body from a flared skirt with a wide rounded hem.

66.description: A beetle seen from above has a long oval shell divided by a straight central seam. Its round head carries two antennae, while three pairs of angular legs spread from the body.

67.description: A curved pickle has a long plump body with rounded ends and a gently indented inner side. Several tiny speckles are scattered across the otherwise smooth surface within the broad outline.

68.description: A small pickup truck appears in side view with a long rounded body and two circular wheels. A raised cab has a sloping front edge above the right wheel and a flat roof.

69.description: An upright rounded smartphone has a large circular camera lens near its upper center and a short lower control mark. Three short rays spread above the top edge to show the camera flash.

73.description: A squat perfume bottle has a rounded rectangular body beneath a stepped neck and tall stopper. A short horizontal tube extends right from the top, ending in a small lobed squeeze bulb.

74.description: A rounded square pegboard contains nine small circular holes in three evenly spaced rows. The holes form a centered grid, leaving a broad unmarked margin inside the softly rounded outer border.

75.description: A low stone wall contains a tall rounded arch opening at its center. Horizontal courses and staggered vertical joints divide the masonry into rectangular blocks around the curved opening and square outer edges.

76.description: A studio lamp on a tripod faces right beside a tall backdrop support. A long rounded crossbar spans overhead, while the lamp has a broad half-round shade and a short rear housing.

77.description: An upright pinecone has overlapping pointed scales arranged in rising rows around a central axis. The outer scales curve inward toward the top, and a short straight stem extends beneath the rounded base.

78.description: A tall oval pecan is divided by a straight vertical seam from top to bottom. Two curved interior grooves bow outward on either side, following the symmetrical shape of the shell.

79.concept: Patio Umbrella over Table and Stools
79.description: A domed patio umbrella has curved panel seams above a long central pole. A short tabletop crosses the pole below the canopy, with two simple stools positioned on either side.

80.description: A large teardrop pendant has a pointed upper tip and a broad rounded lower body. A small circular hanging loop sits directly above its tip, touching the otherwise blank pendant outline.

81.description: A long triangular pennant extends right from a thin vertical pole. Its straight upper and lower edges meet at a sharp outer point, while the pole projects above and below the attached flag.

82.description: Two rounded square outlines overlap diagonally, with the upper one shifted left. Short gaps interrupt several edges around the shared center, while the outer portions remain broad and clearly separated.

85.description: Two large circular eyeglass lenses are joined by a small arched bridge. A slim handle begins at the right lens edge, curves outward, and descends vertically below the round frames.

87.description: Three upright fence pickets have pointed tops and straight sides standing on a common baseline. Two horizontal rails run behind the posts, extending slightly beyond the outer pickets at both ends.

88.description: A long rectangular pier deck rests on three thin vertical supports above a curved wave line. The water rises and falls around the posts, with its ends continuing beyond the outer supports.

89.description: A long adhesive bandage lies diagonally with fully rounded ends and straight parallel sides. Two transverse seams mark a rectangular central pad between the broad blank adhesive sections at either end.

90.description: A diagonal wrench has a long narrow handle with a rounded lower end. Its upper head curves into an open angular jaw, with a broad crescent-shaped outer edge around the opening.

91.description: A plough has a long upper handle slanting down into a broad curved beam. A pointed leaf-shaped share projects beneath it, with a short connecting shank joining the blade to the frame.

93.description: An airplane points right with a long rounded fuselage, swept wings, and a raised tail fin. A small lobed cloud floats separately below its right wing in the otherwise open sky.

94.description: An airplane tail section has a tall swept fin rising on the left and sloping into a low horizontal base. Rounded corners soften the outer tip and rear end of the tail.

95.description: An airplane tilts upward to the right with swept wings and a rounded nose. A short straight runway line sits below the airborne fuselage, separated from the wings and tail by open space.

96.concept: Tall Pint Glass with Rim Band
96.description: A tall pint glass has a broad straight rim and a narrow horizontal band near the top. Its sides curve inward through the middle before ending in a flat rounded base.

97.description: An irregular rounded polyp has several broad outer lobes surrounding curved internal folds. A deep central loop descends from the upper interior, with two shorter curved marks near the lower edge.

98.description: A large circular sun is surrounded by eight separate straight rays spaced around its perimeter. Vertical and horizontal rays alternate with diagonal ones, with a clear open gap around the central disk.

101.description: A tall wine bottle has a narrow straight neck above gently sloping shoulders and a long rounded body. A short horizontal rim line crosses near the top, beneath a softly rounded cap edge.

102.description: A broad triangular porch roof rests above a horizontal beam and two straight columns. The columns stand on a wide rectangular platform, framing a large blank opening beneath the roof.

103.description: A broad lobed storm cloud has a flat lower edge above a sharply angled lightning bolt. The bolt descends from the cloud's underside through two zigzag bends into a pointed tip.

104.description: A deep coffee cup has a straight rim and rounded bowl with a loop handle on the right. A short horizontal saucer line sits beneath the cup, separated by a narrow gap.

105.description: An airplane seen from above has a long rounded fuselage, broad swept wings, and a small divided tail. Two rounded engine pods hang below the wings on opposite sides of the body.

107.description: Several broad curved rows sweep upward from the lower left toward the right side. Shorter opposing curves meet the upper boundary from the left, forming two adjoining sets of planted field rows.

108.description: A thick pipe bends through a rounded right angle from a horizontal left opening to a vertical upper opening. Broad rectangular collars cap both ends, extending slightly beyond the curved pipe walls.

109.description: A broad pipe bends from a vertical lower section into a horizontal arm extending right. Its inner and outer corners curve smoothly, while both open ends have softly rounded rectangular edges.

110.description: A symmetrical vase has a wide flared rim above a narrow neck and a broad rounded belly. Its sides taper toward a short flat base, leaving the entire vessel surface blank.

111.description: A tall rounded rectangular swatch is filled with evenly spaced diagonal stripes rising from left to right. The lines continue to the border, creating a regular pattern across the whole blank panel.

112.description: A wide projector has a low rounded rectangular front with a large circular lens on the left. Two short horizontal ventilation lines sit on the right, centered within the otherwise blank housing.

118.description: A farmer in a brimmed hat leans forward while holding a long plough handle. One leg stretches back, and a curved pointed ploughshare rests on the ground ahead at the lower right.

119.description: Open pruning shears have two long rounded handles spreading below a circular pivot. A broad hooked blade curves upward on the left, crossing a shorter pointed blade that extends to the upper right.

120.description: A pair of open pruning shears stands beside a straight plant stem with two pointed leaves. The shears have a curved upper blade, small central pivot, and two long handles spreading below.

121.description: A tall fuel pump has a rounded rectangular body, broad base, and blank display near the top. A hose curves outward from the right side and rises into a pointed nozzle.

123.description: Two open hands face an open laptop above them, with fingers directed toward its keyboard base. The laptop has a blank upright screen and a short horizontal trackpad mark on its sloping lower panel.

124.description: A hooded figure wears a wide poncho that slopes outward from the shoulders into broad corners. A blank pointed face sits below the curved hood, above the poncho's long rounded lower edge.

126.description: A simple house has a broad triangular roof projecting beyond two straight walls. Two square windows sit side by side above a centered rectangular doorway, with all openings left blank.

127.description: A rear view of the hips widens from a straight cropped waist into rounded outer contours. Two curved lower folds meet at a central crease that continues vertically downward between the legs.

128.description: An almond-shaped eye has pointed ends and smoothly arched upper and lower lids. A large circular iris sits at its center, surrounding a smaller round pupil with an open gap between them.

130.description: A raised hand extends the thumb, index finger, and little finger while folding the two middle fingers inward. A curved palm crease runs from the thumb base toward the center above the open wrist.

133.description: A small bottle has a rounded rectangular body and curved shoulders narrowing into a short neck. A broad rounded cap sits above the neck, with slight gaps where the outlines meet.

134.description: A long upright nail has a broad flat head with rounded corners above a narrow shaft. The shaft tapers slightly downward before ending in a sharply pointed tip below the straight sides.

135.description: An upright computer mouse has a long oval body with rounded top and bottom ends. A single straight seam rises from the lower edge toward the center, leaving the upper half blank.

136.concept: Blank Puppy Head with Round Ears
136.description: A puppy head faces forward with a broad rounded forehead and softly curved cheeks. Two large floppy ears project from the upper sides, surrounding a completely blank face without eyes or muzzle marks.

137.description: A large figure has an oval head with short outward-curving hair above a broad flared body. A small stick-figure child stands centered within the body, with outstretched arms and spread legs.

138.description: A motorboat faces right with a raised cabin, sloping windscreen, and curved pointed bow. Two wavy water lines pass beneath the hull, with the upper wave partly overlapping the boat's lower edge.

140.description: A broad right-pointing triangle sits beside a tall narrow rounded bar. Both shapes have softly curved corners and equal overall height, with a clear vertical gap separating the media-control elements.

141.description: A wide rounded printer has a blank sheet projecting above its top and a larger page emerging below. Two short horizontal text lines sit on the lower page between its rounded corners.

143.description: Three people stand side by side behind a wide blank rectangular banner. Their round heads and curved shoulders rise above it, while three tapered lower bodies extend beneath the sign.

144.description: A triangular pizza slice has a rounded pointed tip and a broad curved crust along its outer edge. Three circular toppings sit on the open face beneath the thick curved crust band.

145.description: A person sits cross-legged beneath a separate circular head, with the torso upright. Both arms curve outward toward rounded hands, while the overlapping bent legs form a wide base below the waist.

146.description: A small person stands at the lower right with both hands meeting around a controller. A larger drone floats above and left, with two raised rotors, a rounded body, and a lower camera housing.

148.description: A closed notebook has rounded corners, a narrow left spine, and a broad blank cover. A rounded clasp extends inward from the middle of the right edge, crossing the cover's outer outline.

149.description: A round table tennis paddle tilts down toward the lower left, with a short handle and diagonal face seam. A small circular ball floats beside the upper left edge of the paddle.

150.description: A horizontal pipe passes through a thick rounded collar at its center. The collar's curved front and side edges show its depth, while the pipe's exposed ends remain straight with rounded corners.
